profile.name: UDP广播数值订阅组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于在局域网中监听UDP广播数据包并接收远程发布的数值消息。在实验环境中可用于在不同主机或进程之间传递传感器读数、状态量或控制参数，便于监视、联动和数据整合。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that listens for UDP broadcast packets on a local network and receives value messages from a remote publisher. In lab workflows, it can be used to pass sensor readings, status values, or control parameters between hosts or processes for monitoring, coordination, and data integration.

registry.name: Open Standard Use Zero Message Queue
registry.description: UDP Value SUB是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括复位、设备连接、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, on message等操作。
